working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF, 0h/12h/24h) cluster typed by the authors as Mi9; cluster is composed primarily of developing Mi9 neurons (immature).
searches_performed: OLS4 REST search fbbt "immature" medulla/transmedullary/amacrine terms

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the medullary intrinsic neuron Mi9 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Opa/Erm temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Authors' typing taken at face value; stage 0-24h APF so the immature term immature medulla intrinsic neuron Mi9 is the matching developing form.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Medulla intrinsic narrow field neuron with a bushy mix of bleb-type and fine terminal arborization in layers M2, M3 and M4 and in the lower medulla layers M9-M10 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Kind et al., 2021). It establishes pre- and post-synaptic connections in both the inner and outer medulla layers (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Morante and Desplan, 2008). It receives input from lamina monopolar neuron L3 (Takemura et al., 2013). It is glutamatergic (Takemura et al., 2017). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature (adult) form; cluster is 0-24h APF so the immature term is used.
